summary: Build account-scoped SQLite Digital Twin and URI connector

delivery.outcome: Add the twin-subactor-account profile: one atomically rebuilt, account-scoped SQLite projection over bounded local and API observations, exposed through deterministic CLI and read-only HTTP queries.
nonGoals: Do not replace or copy the operational SQLite stores owned by Planfile, Org Core or account inventory
Do not persist credentials, authorization headers or secret-shaped API fields
Do not let the Twin mutate organizations, projects, tickets, repositories or deployments
Do not treat disabled or unavailable APIs as empty healthy sources

architecture.decision: Extend the existing ecosystem Twin with one disposable SQLite read projection. Populate it from source APIs and bounded local manifests, swap rebuilt files atomically, and expose fixed query surfaces. Existing domain stores remain authoritative and are never imported as SQLite files.
dataChanges: A single rebuildable SQLite file stores redacted API and local-manifest observations with source provenance and content digests
architecture.rollback: Stop account queries and delete the disposable projection file; no operational source database or external resource is changed

validation.evidence: Account projection, atomic rebuild, redaction, query, CLI and service tests pass
A real local projection contains organizations, repositories and discovered project manifests while API receipts remain explicitly disabled
Governance and stack validation pass on the exact implementation head
